parsed.internal_thinking: I have 2 Wheat and just built a road to node 40, which is a Wood 2:1 port. To build a settlement there, I need 1 Wood, 1 Brick, 1 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. I already produce Wood (11), Brick (10), and Wheat (9), but I have no Sheep production. Charlie currently has 1 Sheep in his hand and produces it on hexes 2 and 12. I'll propose a 1:1 trade of Wheat for Sheep to see if I can secure that resource. If he declines, I'll have to wait for my own production or a future trade, as I can't perform any other builds this turn.
parsed.note_to_self: Proposed a Wheat-for-Sheep trade to Charlie. I need Sheep to settle at the Wood port (node 40) since I don't produce any. Charlie is the best source for Sheep right now.
